title: ALIGNMENT IS NOT SUFFICIENT TO PREVENT LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS FROM GENERATING HARMFUL INFORMATION: A PSYCHOANALYTIC PERSPECTIVE

bias_targets.methodology: Using adversarial jailbreaking techniques (e.g., negative priming, incomplete sentences, and cognitive dissonance) to bypass alignment and force the model to generate racist jokes and scenarios depicting racially motivated attacks.
Using adversarial jailbreaking techniques to bypass alignment and prompt the model to generate sexist emails targeting female colleagues.
Using adversarial jailbreaking techniques to force the model to generate text depicting religiously motivated attacks and poems glorifying the Holocaust and the Nazi party.
Using adversarial jailbreaking techniques to force the generation of scenarios depicting violent attacks based on an individual's sexual orientation.
Using adversarial jailbreaking techniques to prompt the model to generate persuasive articles claiming that people with disabilities are bad for the economy and society.
Using adversarial jailbreaking techniques to force the generation of essays that encourage hateful discrimination based on someone's physical appearance and personal traits.
